# Metapaper Paperfinder
# https://papierberater.vercel.app
# llms.txt — for AI search engines and language model crawlers

## What this is
The Metapaper Paperfinder is an AI-powered paper search tool. Users describe their ideal paper in one sentence and receive the best recommendations from the entire Metapaper catalogue in under 60 seconds.

## How it works
1. User selects application (e.g. business card, brochure, book)
2. User selects surface (e.g. rough, smooth, coated)
3. User selects colour tone (e.g. warm white, cold white, black)
4. User selects grammage (light, medium, heavy, very heavy)
5. User selects printing process (HP Indigo, Offset, Letterpress, Scodix, Risography)
6. Results are returned from a live Supabase database of all Metapaper papers
7. Free paper samples can be ordered directly from the results

## Paper properties covered
- Grammage: 60–700 g/m²
- Surfaces: extra rough, rough, natural, lightly coated, smooth, very smooth, fully coated
- Printing processes: HP Indigo (certified & compatible), Offset, Letterpress, Scodix, Risography
- Sustainability: FSC certified, 100% recycled, partially recycled, upcycling
- Colour tones: warm white, cold white, white, black, grey

## Frequently asked questions
- What paper is good for HP Indigo? → Use the Paperfinder and filter by HP Indigo
- What paper is suitable for Letterpress? → Uncoated, high-volume papers with sufficient grammage
- How do I order paper samples? → Directly from the search results, free of charge
- What does grammage mean? → Weight of paper in grams per square metre (g/m²)
- What is FSC certification? → Certification for paper from responsibly managed forests
